items.name: Back to Buchy 2025
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#54927-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). 

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#54927-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.name: Campeonato do Cerrado 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODQzMTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--06d2967b0812abd2b9d69605b49b7f3dd989cb08/Logo.png)

🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatodoCerrado2025/register). 
Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição.

---

🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](\(https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatodoCerrado2025/register) tab.

If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M). 

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition.

items.name: Mahalo iā Maui 2025
items.information:
# This competition may be pushed to a different date due to a possible conflict. Please avoid booking accomodations until registration has opened.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Come join us for our annual WCA competition on the beautiful island of Maui!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.

items.name: Rubik's x TheCubicle CubingUSA All-Stars 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTA2MzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7258c24bf15932193bf6e7c1158b18b3dc89d62f/nats-2025-logo.jpg)

We are excited to present Rubik's x TheCubicle CubingUSA All-Star Championship 2025, the 2025 US National Championship!

Please refer to the competition website for full details. We expect the qualification standards to be very competitive, so many interested competitors may not be able to participate.
